Silverline.AssetDef.label: Mattress Plus
Silverline.AssetDef.description: A savings account. The money lies in a very secure mattress and grows a little. In a bank run withdrawals are locked for two days.

Silverline.AssetDef.label: Outlander Union Infrastructure Bond
Silverline.AssetDef.description: Loans to a union of outlander towns that is building roads, wells and one disputed bridge. Pays on time, until it does not. After a default you get roughly a third back.

Silverline.AssetDef.label: Empire War Bonds
Silverline.AssetDef.description: Bonds that finance a war of the Empire. When the war ends in victory they jump, in defeat they are worth a nice frame. The war has been going on for a long time, mostly in the brochures.

Silverline.AssetDef.label: RimIndex 50
Silverline.AssetDef.description: The fifty biggest companies of the rim in one product. The reference for everything else on this page: the profitability slider is defined by what this one earns on average.

Silverline.AssetDef.label: MCTN, League of Micaton
Silverline.AssetDef.description: Shares of a league of outlander towns. Quarterly numbers move the price; so do your relations with the league, a little. It pays no dividend but sends a lovely calendar.

Silverline.AssetDef.label: HIDE, Hide and Hearth Cooperative
Silverline.AssetDef.description: Shares of a tribal cooperative that sells hides, hearth wood and an astonishing amount of hospitality. Highly dependent on the weather and on the mood of one very large uncle.

Silverline.AssetDef.label: IMPR, Imperial Pageantry Ltd
Silverline.AssetDef.description: The company behind the imperial ceremonies: banners, trumpets and tiny crowns. Profits depend on how many nobles feel offended by how little.

Silverline.AssetDef.label: HHH, Hearth Harbor Holdings
Silverline.AssetDef.description: A holding that owns exactly one thing: the idea that your colony is a destination. Reacts to your wealth and to raids you survive. You have a stake in its success, but so does everybody who read this.

Silverline.AssetDef.label: Glitterworld Growth Fund
Silverline.AssetDef.description: An actively managed fund. The managers have a very impressive brochure and a boat. Their skill is, on average, slightly negative, and it was fixed when the fund was founded.
Silverline.AssetDef.tagline: Our managers beat the market (we did not say which market).

Silverline.AssetDef.label: Piety Bonds
Silverline.AssetDef.description: Bonds backed by the donations of seventeen faiths, each convinced the other sixteen are doing it wrong. Steady, solemn, and very slightly smug.

Silverline.AssetDef.label: Relic Futures
Silverline.AssetDef.description: Futures on relics that may or may not exist, to be delivered by a courier who may or may not be a prophet. The contract was blessed.

Silverline.AssetDef.label: RimCoin
Silverline.AssetDef.description: A digital coin that is entirely made of electricity and conviction. Swings several percent a day, makes jumps nobody can explain and sits on an exchange that has been hacked before. And will be.
Silverline.AssetDef.tagline: Trust the maths. Not the exchange.

Silverline.AssetDef.label: $THRUMBO
Silverline.AssetDef.description: A coin named after a rare beast and backed by exactly as much. The whitepaper is a drawing of a thrumbo. The founder is, according to the drawing, a thrumbo.
Silverline.AssetDef.tagline: To the moon, on foot, slowly.

Silverline.AssetDef.label: Boomalope Coin
Silverline.AssetDef.description: A coin that explodes in value. And occasionally just explodes. Popular among people who like the smell of burning money.
Silverline.AssetDef.tagline: Volatile by design, flammable by nature.

Silverline.AssetDef.label: MUFFALO MOON
Silverline.AssetDef.description: The community coin of everybody who loves muffalo and nothing else. Its roadmap is a picture of a muffalo looking at the moon. The roadmap has not changed.

Silverline.AssetDef.label: Non-Fungible Thrumbos
Silverline.AssetDef.description: A collection of pictures of thrumbos, each unique, each a little bit like the others. You own a receipt for a picture of a picture. Buyers appear slowly and want a discount.

Silverline.AssetDef.label: Certificate of Ownership: Picture of a Muffalo
Silverline.AssetDef.description: An ownership certificate of a picture of a muffalo. The picture is stored somewhere. The certificate is stored in your account. Neither of them smells of muffalo.
Silverline.AssetDef.tagline: You own the idea of the picture.
